steps.en: Install the single binary with the published installer script
steps.zh: 用官方安装脚本装好单二进制

steps.en: Ask for a page as Markdown
Loads the URL, runs the page's JavaScript in V8, waits for the load to settle
steps.zh: 加载页面，在 V8 里跑 JS，等页面稳定

steps.en: Serializes the live DOM to Markdown — layout and paint never run
steps.zh: 把实时 DOM 序列化成 Markdown——布局和渲染全程没跑

value.en: Your agent gets JS-rendered page content from one binary — no Chrome, no driver, no paying for pixels
value.zh: agent 拿一个二进制就取到 JS 渲染后的内容——不装 Chrome、不伺候驱动、不为像素付钱

sources: README.md Quick start / Direct installation (curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://github.com/lexmount/moli/releases/latest/download/moli-installer.sh | sh)
README.md CLI usage (moli fetch --dump markdown --wait-until done https://example.com; semantic_tree_text; --layout for screenshot/pdf; wait options)
README.md Why Moli + Cost controls (default LayoutPolicy::Mock skips layout/paint; DOM+style is the single source of truth; FrozenLayoutTree rebuilt per request; --layout enables real geometry)
